content:
I'm running a Formalizing Fermat workshop, July 6th to 10th (2026). It's an in person workshop in London. The workshop is sponsored by Logos AI, a new tech startup (currently in stealth mode) based at Imperial College London and focussed on autoformalization.

The two aims of the workshop are
(1) to formalize parts of the proof of "1980s theorems => FLT"
(2) to experiment with autoformalization of the relevant 1980s theorems.

Logos AI will give successful applicants access to their autoformalization tool, which they will be able to experiment with during the workshop. All accommodation and travel is also being paid for by Logos AI.

Register your interest using the online google form here. Applications close 3 weeks today at 1 minute to midnight London time three days later than previously announced, on Friday 22nd May at 1 minute to midnight London time, which is 2026-05-22T23:59:00+01:00 , because I just realised that I'll be travelling Tuesday to Friday so will be in no position to start filtering applications. I regret that with high probability I will not be able to accommodate everybody.

Discussions/questions should be posted not in this thread, but in the corresponding thread here #FLT > Formalizing Fermat Workshop @ 💬

Looking forward to the event!

For the curious, here’s a bit more about Logos Research
. https://www.logosresearch.ai/
. https://sosv.com/logos-research-is-new-math-the-answer-to-ai-slop-code/

More exciting news coming soon...
